rv.q: Overall, it’s chock-full of chuckles and cheer.
If you love animals or love an animal lover, The Dog Show will entertain and bring joy.
If it’s not a howlingly funny show, it’s still solidly amusing and warmhearted.
Beneath the punch lines, the production finds something affectionate and familiar in the bond between dogs and people.

Playwright David Javerbaum's experience as an executive producer and head writer of "The Daily Show with Jon Stewart" shows as he infuses a razor-sharp wit into bite-sized, easily digestible dialogue.

cn.t: Critics praise *The Dog Show* as a clever, charming comedy. David Javerbaum's witty dog-perspective monologues and the four versatile performers earn consistent applause.
